title: Analysis code: limits of sociodemographic data for predicting postpartum readmission, with a decision-economic analysis (nuMoM2b)
description: Code for the revised manuscript comparing conventional, ensemble and automated machine learning for 14-day postpartum readmission in the nuMoM2b cohort at equal workload, with a decision-economic analysis, post hoc state transport and a post hoc search over variables recorded before discharge. Contains code only: no data, predictions or result files. nuMoM2b data are available from NICHD DASH under a data use agreement.
